dispatch.buttons: ButtonListener -> ButtonProcessor.queue: HandlerRegistry.resolve(customId) = longest registered @ButtonHandler(value) that is a prefix of the id after ComponentIdEnvelope.decode strips FFCC_<faction>_ / dummyPlayerSpoof<faction>_ and deleteThisButton/deleteThisMessage markers. Unmatched -> "We couldn't resolve what to do with this button."
dispatch.selects: SelectionMenuListener -> SelectionMenuProcessor: same registry over @SelectionHandler, then legacy SelectionManager (Selection.accept) list.
dispatch.modals: ModalListener: registry over @ModalHandler, then hard-coded jmfA_ settings-framework fallback (MiltySettings / DraftSystemSettings / Franken / BaseGameMiniMilty parseInput).
dispatch.ownership: ListenerContext.isPressedByOwner: FFCC_<faction>_ ids may only be pressed by that faction (firmament<->obsidian and Onyxxa granted holders excepted); others get "these buttons are for someone else". dummyPlayerSpoof<faction>_ makes the press act as that (NPC/dummy) player. Non-players are rejected except showGameAgain and combat-replay bets.
dispatch.handlerParams: Handlers receive (event, Game, Player presser, String componentId, MessageChannel, ...) by reflection; @ButtonHandler(save=false) takes a read lock and skips save.

fieldLegend.grammar.patterns: creation-site id expressions rendered with {placeholders}; placeholder names are guessed from the Java expression (tilePos, planet, faction, color, unit, n, sc, tech, leader, relic, pn, ac, so, objective, agenda, cardId, token, userId, messageId, player, type, or the variable name). FFCC_{faction}_ owner prefix removed (see target).
fieldLegend.target.summary: explicit:ffcc = every creation site prefixes FFCC_<owner>_; explicit:private-thread / ephemeral-to-presser / presser-modal; each-player = reaction/follow/vote window every player answers; implicit:* = posted to a shared channel with no owner check (actions channel + mention, same channel as the press, edit-in-place); mixed = some sites explicit; unknown = no creation site resolved.
fieldLegend.target.ownerVars: Java receiver of factionButtonChecker() at creation sites (player = the actor in that method; target/opponent/p2 = someone else is being asked).
fieldLegend.handler.resolvesFromId: lookups the handler body performs (tile by position, planet unit holder, player from colour/faction, parseInt...) - evidence of encoded fields.
fieldLegend.kind: proposed typed decision kind (see kinds); kindRule says which rule fired: prefix:* (hand rule), fields (grammar), area-default (weak).
